sentences.en: The sparrow landed on the perch of the bird feeder.
sentences.zh: 麻雀落在了鸟食器上的栖木上。

sentences.en: The blue bird is perched on a branch, singing cheerfully.
sentences.zh: 蓝鸟停在树枝上欢快地歌唱。

sentences.en: The startled black-bird chirps complainingly from her perch on the wall.
sentences.zh: 受惊的黑鸟从墙上的栖息处叽叽喳喳地抱怨着。

senses.zh: 栖息处，栖枝，栖木 - 高处，较高的位置 - 鲈鱼 -
(在较高处或物体边缘)坐着；把…置于较高或危险处
